purpose: Characterize where the qualified C1R bilinear face law is continuous but only piecewise differentiable, and freeze fail-closed tangent semantics for node lines, equal-head shortcut and head-envelope edges.

internal_node_characterization.method: evaluate the exact same node head from the left cell with fraction 1 and right cell with fraction 0; compare flux and one-sided derivatives without smoothing
internal_node_characterization.derivative_jump: descriptive; finite one-sided values required but equality is not required

tail_characterization.hard_requirement: finite flux and endpoint derivatives; no extrapolation and no head-envelope endpoint claim

equal_head_limit.generic_limit: evaluate bilinear face law at h_a=h_b inside a table cell, without invoking the production equal-head shortcut
equal_head_limit.shortcut: production C1R lookup returns K(h) on exact equal-head branch
record: generic endpoint derivatives and diagonal derivative sum
equal_head_limit.admission_semantics: no unique cross-branch derivative claim; exact equal-head shortcut is an explicit separate branch. Gap is characterization, not silently averaged into a tangent.

hydrostatic_condition.meaning: at zero driving gradient the bilinear law must give q=0 and dq/dh_a=-dq/dh_b for the frozen face law

hard_gates: all internal node fluxes are continuous across left/right cell representations to scaled 1e-12
all one-sided node derivatives are finite
all high-conductivity and dry-tail interior probes are finite and remain inside the qualified envelope
all hydrostatic probes satisfy scaled q <= 1e-12 and derivative antisymmetry <= 1e-12
shared C1R table remains bitwise unchanged
no smoothing or derivative averaging is introduced

piecewise_tangent_policy.strict_cell_interior: qualified analytic derivative and J1B-R1 same-factorization response tangent may be used
piecewise_tangent_policy.internal_node_line: flux remains continuous; derivative is one-sided/piecewise and a unique smooth tangent must not be invented
piecewise_tangent_policy.fd_or_trial_crosses_node: classify as regime switch and retry/route/fallback rather than average across cells
piecewise_tangent_policy.exact_equal_head_shortcut: separate branch; do not claim the strict-interior bilinear tangent through the branch switch
piecewise_tangent_policy.head_envelope_endpoints: no unique derivative claim; fail closed or use explicit one-sided boundary policy
piecewise_tangent_policy.dry_and_high_K_interior: normal strict-interior tangent semantics remain available when the probe is not on an excluded branch

exit_rule.fail: Keep J1 incomplete and classify continuity, nonfinite or branch-semantics failure without table retuning.

scope_guards: No saturation, heterogeneity, groundwater, crop/process physics or production admission.
